title: Sites

static.name: Static
static.description: HTML, CSS and JavaScript files served as they are.

php.name: PHP
php.description: A PHP application with a PHP-FPM pool of its own.

proxy.name: Reverse proxy
proxy.description: Forwards requests to an application listening elsewhere.

app.name: App (Node.js / Python / Go / Java / .NET)
app.description: A long-running program, run as a service behind nginx.

delete.title: Delete site {site}?
delete.text: The web server configuration of {site} is removed, so its domains are no longer served.
delete.files: Also delete the files and users
delete.filesOn: {dir} and the users {owner} and {runner} are deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.filesOff: {dir} and the site’s users are kept, so the files are still there if you create the site again.

empty.title: No sites yet
empty.text: A site serves one or more domains from this server: static files, a PHP application with a PHP-FPM pool of its own, or a reverse proxy to an application. Each site gets its own directory and users.

unsupported.selinux: Sites are not available on this system yet (SELinux support is being verified).

statusUnavailable: The panel could not check whether nginx and PHP are installed.
nginxMissing: nginx is not installed, so sites cannot be created yet.
installNginx: Install nginx on the software page
nginxStopped: nginx is installed but not running.

form.domainsHint: Press Enter after each domain. Wildcards (*.example.com) and IPv4 addresses work; international names are converted automatically. No ports.
form.codeHint: A short name for the site directory and users, fixed once the site exists. Leave it empty to derive it from the first domain.
form.webSocketHint: Pass WebSocket connections through to the upstream.
form.upstreamHostHint: The upstream receives its own host name instead of the domain the visitor asked for.
form.noPhp: No PHP version with PHP-FPM is installed.
form.installPhp: Install PHP on the software page
form.rootHint: Relative to the site directory, for example public for Laravel. Leave it empty to serve the directory itself.
form.indexHint: File names tried when a directory is requested. Leave empty for the defaults.
form.writableHint: Directories the site may write to, relative to the site directory (uploads, caches). Everything else stays read-only to it.
form.certHint: Only valid certificates that cover every domain of the site are listed.
form.certNotCovering: The certificate does not cover every domain of the site.
form.redirectHint: Visitors who come over HTTP are sent to HTTPS.
form.hstsHint: Browsers then refuse plain HTTP for this site for a long time, even if HTTPS is turned off later. Turn it on only when HTTPS is meant to stay.

overview.users: {owner} owns the files; deploy code as this user. The site runs as {runner}, which can read the files but write only the writable directories, so a compromised site cannot change its own code.

drift.title: The last change did not take effect
drift.text: What the system runs differs from these settings.

app.runtimeHint: Installed runtimes only; the chosen one comes first on PATH.
app.installRuntime: Install a runtime on the software page
app.commandHint: One shell line, run by /bin/sh as the site's runtime user. The app must listen on 127.0.0.1:$PORT; HOST and PORT are set for it.
app.envHint: HOST, PORT, HOME and PATH are set by the panel. Values are stored in a file only root can read.
app.writableHint: The app can write only these directories and tmp/; everything else is read-only to it.
app.limitsHint: Memory in MB (at least 16); CPU in percent of one CPU (200 = two CPUs, at least 5). Empty means no limit.
app.healthHint: The panel requests this path every 30 seconds. After three failures (no answer, or status 500 or higher) it restarts the app.
app.noSystemd: Needs systemd, which this system does not have.

process.healthFailing: Health check failing ({count} time) | Health check failing ({count} times)
